facts.fact: A validation workshop was under way in Windhoek on Namibia's AfCFTA Digital Trade Regulatory Assessment of gaps in its legal, regulatory and institutional framework against the Protocol on Digital Trade, to feed a National Digital Trade Action Plan; the document states no national law passed to give effect to the Protocol and gives no workshop date, so the published date 2026-10-05 is used.

The Minister of Information and Communication Technology tabled the African Union Convention on Cyber Security and Personal Data Protection in Parliament for ratification and said Namibia was encouraged to ratify it, so it had not ratified; the document is dated 2018 only, which is its published date.
